{"id":1686474273,"question_id":3600,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year","timestamp":1751653132,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1686474273/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find the K-th Character in String Game I","memory":"7.9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    char kthCharacter(int k) {\n        int len = 1;\n        while(len < k)\n        {\n            len *= 2;\n        }\n        int shift_needed = 0;\n        while(len > 1)\n        {\n            int half = len / 2;\n            if(k > half)\n            {\n                k = k - half;\n                shift_needed ++;\n            }\n            len = half;\n        }\n\n        int result = 'a' + shift_needed;\n        if(result > 'k')\n        {\n            result = result - 26;\n        }\n        return result;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-the-k-th-character-in-string-game-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":694}
